Let $C$ be the number of CSFs in a full CI calculation of $\mathrm{CH}_2 \mathrm{SiHF}$ using a 6-31G** basis set.
The number of CSFs in a full CI calculation of $\mathrm{CH}_2 \mathrm{SiHF}$ using a 6-31G** basis set is given by
$$C = \frac{1}{6} \cdot \text{number of CSFs in the full CI calculation}$$
In this case, the full CI calculation is $\mathrm{CH}_2 \mathrm{SiHF}$.
So, the number of CSFs in the full CI calculation is
$$C = \frac{1}{6} \cdot 1 = \frac{1}{6}$$
Therefore, the number of CSFs in a full CI calculation of $\mathrm{CH}_2 \mathrm{SiHF}$ using a 6-31G** basis set is $\frac{1}{6}$.
